headline: Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raises $8M to run AI on satellites
context: Satlyt wants to be the Android of orbital computing, offering open software that works on many companies' satellites, versus SpaceX's closed, all-in-one iPhone-style approach.
